title: Victoria’s Young Australian of the Year: Ryan Brigham wins award; charity raises over $500,000
summary_full: Ryan Brigham founded the charity Health in Focus after facing serious health challenges and hospital stays. The initiative has mobilized over 800 young volunteers to improve healthcare access both locally and internationally. It has raised more than $500,000 to deliver health education and resources to underserved communities. Healthcare programs like mobile cardiac screening clinics target early detection of cardiovascular issues.
